Name: SkateHorse (Content Patcher)
Author: orpheusmods
Description:
[size=4]Ever wanted to look infinitely cooler riding around town? Well, now you can! Why do you need 100 hardwood, 5 iron bars, and 10,000g to buy a skateboard? Don't worry about it![/size]

[size=3]My friend saw Sam trying to do a kickflip and was immediately disappointed they could not skate around town themselves. I knew I had to be the change I wanted to see in the world.[/size]
[size=3]
[b]This mod:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Changes the horse texture[/size]
[*][size=3]Changes the farmer riding the horse texture so that it appears they are skating and not sitting on empty air[/size]
[*][size=3]Changes the pants to be compatible with the new riding texture[/size]
[*][size=3]Modifies references to horses to become about skateboards[/size]
[*][size=3]Is compatible with all farmer appearances[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Requires:[/b] Content Patcher and SMAPI.

[b]How to Install: [/b]Follow the installation procedures for Content Patcher and SMAPI. Download this mod, extract the zip file into a folder, and place that folder in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

[size=3][b]Recommended Mods: [/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10446]Horse Squeeze [/url]by jorgamun - allows horses to move through one-tile spaces
[/size]This mod is compatible with all versions of SkateHorse. It will allow you to realistically traverse the town, given that the skateboard takes up less width than you do.[size=3]
[b]
[/b][/size][b]Potential future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changing the stable texture to something fitting for a skateboard
[*]Creating alternative skateboard designs
[*]Changing the cost and materials needed to acquire the skateboard
[*]Option to toggle whether or not the skateboard is still called a horse
[*]Adding protective skating gear
[*]Potentially changing the audio to something more skate-y. Honestly I think the horse clopping does kind of sound like a skateboard on a bumpy road, though.
[/list]
Please notify me if you encounter any glitches or quality concerns! I did not playtest every possible combination of farmer and pants.
